summary: Tested 3 new features: SAP Write admin page (nav dropdown + passcode gate + bulk push + stop button + pushed table), Purchasing Plan Suppliers column, Inventory Entity filter. All features work correctly via both direct API calls and UI/Playwright testing. No code bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: sap_price_spec_client.bulk_push_erp_prices_to_sap and server.py bulk-push endpoints are well structured with cooperative cancellation via is_cancelled polling - verified working end-to-end (API + UI).
SapWritePage.js passcode gate is intentionally client-side only per explicit user request (no real auth) - correctly documented in code comments and test_credentials.md.
No blocking issues found in NavTabs.jsx dropdown, PurchasingPlanPage.js supplier badge rendering, or InventoryPage.js entity filter/column additions.
test_credentials: N/A - app has no end-user auth. SAP Write passcode 'admin' verified working.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing test data (SPC5WM -> 165 DEGREE 60% Preferred assignment) already present in Mongo per handoff notes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 features verified: (1) Admin dropdown nav with Component Master + SAP Write links renders correctly; SAP Write passcode gate rejects wrong passcode with error, accepts 'admin', persists unlock via sessionStorage across reload. Bulk push start button triggers job, progress bar polls and updates (processed/total), Stop button successfully cancels job - verified via direct API (job transitioned running->done with cancelled:true within ~30s of stop request) AND via UI (Playwright clicked Stop, result banner 'Bulk push stopped by user (partial result)' appeared with correct badges). Pushed/Failed tables render conditionally (not exercised with actual pushed rows in this test run since job was stopped early with 0 pushed - table code was reviewed and matches spec structurally). (2) Purchasing Plan: generated a real plan (took ~114s due to flaky SAP tenant, expected), Suppliers column appears right after UOM, shows 'No supplier assigned' for unassigned rows, and confirmed real data for SPC5WM row showing '165 DEGREE 60%' badge text matching the pre-existing assignment. (3) Inventory: Entity filter dropdown renders next to Site filter, defaults to 'All Entities', only shows that one option (cache lacks company_code data - matches known infra limitation stated in problem), selecting/rendering doesn't crash the page, and expanded location rows show an Entity cell (data-testid=inventory-location-entity-{product_id}) rendering '—' as expected. All observed SAP-related backend warnings (connect timeouts to my431827.businessbydesign.cloud.sap) are pre-existing infra flakiness, not code bugs, consistent with the note given by main agent.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in this round.
